title: Rapea local vocabulary
description: Versioned, locally stored vocabulary records for Argentine freestyle practice. Phonetic fields remain null until reviewed by a person.

schemaVersion.description: Increment when the dataset contract changes.

entries.description: Entry IDs must be unique. JSON Schema cannot enforce uniqueness of one property across records.

term.description: Display form; preserve accents and capitalization as curated.

syllables.description: Reviewed syllable segmentation, or null until reviewed.

stressSyllable.description: One-based index into syllables, or null until reviewed. Must not exceed the syllable count.

phoneticFamily.description: Human-curated rhyme-family key, or null until reviewed. Not an automatic phonetic claim.

label.description: Optional editorial category, such as a topic or challenge type.

region.description: Optional, human-reviewed regional note; omit when not established.

notes.description: Optional editorial note about the Argentine usage or pronunciation.

reviewStatus.description: Reviewed records require syllables, stress, and a phonetic-family key.

entry.$comment: Additional semantic checks: IDs are unique within entries; a non-null stressSyllable must be <= syllables.length. Review pronunciation and rhyme-family membership with Argentine speakers before marking reviewed.
